name: Software Code Audit Pipeline
task: Perform a comprehensive code audit: scan security, analyze style, review architecture, measure performance, then merge reports and generate final audit document

agents.name: Security Scanner
agents.prompt: Scan the entire codebase for security vulnerabilities: hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, XSS, insecure crypto, path traversal, and missing input validation. Output a structured report.

agents.name: Code Style Checker
agents.prompt: Run style analysis across the codebase: check for consistent naming conventions, code formatting, unused imports, dead code, and comment coverage. Output findings.

agents.name: Architecture Reviewer
agents.prompt: Review the high-level architecture: module boundaries, dependency graph, coupling/cohesion metrics, circular dependencies, and adherence to design patterns. Output an architecture assessment.

agents.name: Performance Analyzer
agents.prompt: Analyze performance hotspots: identify O(n²) algorithms, excessive allocations, blocking I/O, unoptimized queries, and memory leaks. Output performance report.

agents.name: Dependency Scanner
agents.prompt: Scan all third-party dependencies: check for known CVEs, outdated versions, license compliance issues, and supply chain risks. Output dependency audit.

agents.name: Report Merger
agents.prompt: Merge all individual analysis reports (security, style, architecture, performance, dependencies) into a unified audit document. De-duplicate findings, prioritize by severity, and create an executive summary.

agents.name: Final Documentation
agents.prompt: Generate the final PDF/HTML audit report with executive summary, detailed findings by category, remediation recommendations, and an appendix with raw data. Format professionally.
